title: Text Transform preset 2 (arch under) on "OpenStitch" at the default level
description: "OpenStitch" in Lato Bold, 10 mm, centred at (50, 50) mm, with Text Transform preset 2 (arch under) at the level PE-DESIGN 11.50 applies when the preset is clicked (stored value 30.000). A second string next to text-transform-2's HHHHHHH: this one has round letters, ascenders, descenders and digits, so the envelope is checked on letters of unequal height. The box of the transformed text is compared; the stitch count is not (text fill rows, audit 'Text fill rows').

evidence.note: compat/reference/text/text-transform-2-openstitch.pes, PE-DESIGN 11.50 (pe-refs-4, 2026-10-29): box 61.4..138.2 x 70.3..100.2 mm, 1457 stitches, transform value 30.000, arch radius 38.4 mm.

PE-DESIGN 11.50 has no numeric Transform level: the strength is a green diamond handle dragged on the canvas, and the value stored in the file is a percentage of the font size for the straight-edged presets (default 50, or 20 for the bows and waves), an angle in degrees for the slants (10) and fans (30), and for the arches the half-sweep angle (30) with the radius that keeps the text length. Files at four other handle positions per preset are parked in the owner's round-4 notes for the text track.

references.make: As text-transform-2, with the text "OpenStitch" instead of HHHHHHH: Lato Bold 10 mm, Fill Stitch 800 RED, under sewing off, density 5.0, Alignment Center, clicked at (50, 50) mm; Text Attributes > Transform on, preset 2 in reading order, the handle left where the preset put it. Save As PES (default type).
